clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, newly awakened Forsaken face a test against the Rattlecage Skeletons. Shadow Priest Sarvis sends them to destroy twelve skeletons and prove they can defend their hard-won freedom.

Newly risen Forsaken face a harder trial after culling the mindless zombies in Deathknell. Shadow Priest Sarvis sends recruits against the Rattlecage Skeletons roaming the settlement’s outskirts. The animated bones have no sapience or self-control, yet strike harder and fight more fiercely than the nearby decaying corpses. Surviving their clattering ambushes shows Sarvis that a recruit can withstand immediate pressure.

Destroying the skeletons protects Deathknell from the lingering grip of the Lich King and tests which recruits can endure the fight. Those who fail or hesitate risk becoming like the mindless wretches wandering the woods. Overcoming the Rattlecages proves to Sarvis that you have the mettle to face a world that despises your existence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've shown your potential to the Forsaken under normal circumstances friend - now let's see you under pressure.

The Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far. Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the Forsaken. Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Those who dally in this task might as well end up wandering about aimlessly like our fallen brothers and sisters in the village. Let's hope you will fare better than them, yes?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am finished with you, friend - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given. Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.
Take these and be on your way. You have much to accomplish, warlock.
